snippet.title: Bonnie knew everyone was expecting more from her 😔#harrypotter #shorts
snippet.description:
Bonnie Wright has revealed in interviews that she felt pressured during the Harry Potter filming. It was a massive role, and many of Ginny's scenes from the books were cut—scenes that were actually worth showing. She was disappointed.
